raw:
@q query
  select ?m
  where match
    relation "mean"
    role subject "TUPE transfer"
    role object ?m
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "take over from"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Corbelle Facilities"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "be cleaners"
  role subject ?p
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
